# UsageDeck 0.6.1

This stabilisation release makes rapid settings changes and interrupted usage refreshes more reliable, and makes Claude usage refreshes near-instant.

## Improvements

- Claude usage is now read directly from the same usage service the Claude CLI uses, so refreshes complete in under a second instead of launching a Claude session each time. If the usage service cannot be reached, UsageDeck falls back to reading the CLI as before.

## Fixes

- Rapidly enabling or disabling several providers now preserves every change instead of allowing one change to overwrite another.
- A usage refresh interrupted by a closed or cancelled request no longer causes the next refresh to reuse the completed request.
- Claude no longer lists the same limit more than once when its usage panel repaints while being read.
- Claude weekly limits now show their reset time instead of "Reset time unavailable".
- Claude usage is read reliably when its panel renders without spacing, which previously showed the limits as unreadable.
- Claude usage is captured until its panel has finished drawing, so a slow-arriving per-model weekly limit is no longer missed.
